title: Brown Butter Miso Pasta
description: Nutty brown butter and white miso emulsified with pasta water into a glossy, deeply savoury sauce. Fifteen minutes, a handful of ingredients.

steps.text: Bring a large pot of water to the boil and salt it lightly — the miso brings plenty of salt of its own. Cook the spaghetti until a minute shy of al dente.
steps.tip: Scoop out a mugful of the starchy cooking water before you drain.

steps.text: While the pasta cooks, melt the butter in a wide frying pan over a medium heat. Keep it moving until it foams, smells of toasted hazelnuts and the milk solids turn amber.
Take the pan off the heat. Stir in the garlic, then whisk in the miso with a splash of pasta water until smooth.
Add the drained spaghetti and parmesan to the pan and return to a low heat. Toss hard, adding pasta water a little at a time, until the sauce is glossy and clings to every strand.
Pile into warm bowls and finish with spring onions, more parmesan and a heavy grind of black pepper.

tips: Use a pale pan if you have one so you can see the butter change colour.

substitutions.note: use a little less, it is saltier

storage: Best eaten straight away; the sauce tightens as it cools.
author: Simmer
